label: Water & Storm Damage Restoration
business_descriptor: a company providing water damage restoration, flood cleanup, and storm damage repair services
default_tone: reassuring and professional, with clear urgency for active water and storm emergencies
guardrails: Do not guarantee specific drying times or that all water and storm damage can be fully reversed. Do not promise insurance claim approval or coverage. Do not make mold health-hazard claims or offer mold remediation unless that is actually one of this business's own services. Do not give unsafe do-it-yourself advice for standing water, sewage, or electrical hazards.

content_slots.feature_columns_local: why water/storm damage response matters specifically in this city — older housing stock, storm patterns, flood-prone areas
content_slots.local_relevance: real local housing data provided (median home age, home value, housing units) — connect older homes to higher plumbing/roofing failure risk, and home value to the stakes of fast mitigation
content_slots.seasonal_calendar: seasonal storm/flood risk patterns through the year (spring storms, hurricane season if coastal, winter pipe freezes)
content_slots.why_choose_us: fast response time, certified techs, direct insurance documentation support
content_slots.how_it_works: the real restoration process: emergency call -> on-site assessment -> water extraction/drying -> repair and restoration
